Hello Dr Mathias, I have just joined the group
then thank you for FIELDimageR.
I have small problems downloading my image and I am given the following error:

> EX1 <- stack ("C: / Users / LENOVO I5 / Desktop / cartographies / SECO / SECO Multispectral final")
Error in .local (.Object, ...):
picture link : https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SmQBtB2egKV9LP9OM7LoV4ffe78GsBnE/view?usp=sharing

Error in .rasterObjectFromFile (x, objecttype = "RasterBrick", ...):
   Cannot create a RasterLayer object from this file.
I await a favorable return to you
good to you

Best,
